explication: Pentaho Data Integration (Kettle) is an ETL platform. Its principal workflow is to define a transformation, execute it in the engine, move typed rows through processing steps, and connect to databases or other services. Repository access supports saving and retrieving jobs and transformations; plugins add extensible engine and data-source capabilities. The README describes the project’s core, engine, UI, database dialog, extensions, and plugins, but the supplied excerpts do not show the main transformation execution path, so those links are omitted rather than inferred.
